research_notes: The final result should include workload-profile coverage because a cap validated only on W3 cannot automatically claim universal safety.
At minimum representative reasoning-heavy and I/O-heavy profiles should be sampled near the candidate cap.
If all converge, a universal cap is justified more strongly.
If not, choose the lower safe envelope or document conditional policy.
This cross-profile step belongs before final policy promotion.
Current 14m W3 sample is one component of that evidence base.
